About Hair Hotties

A trusted name for wigs and wig-making in Haatso

Hair Hotties is a wig shop and training studio built around one idea: hair should make you feel classy, put-together, and completely yourself. We hand-make custom lace-front and ready-to-wear wigs — straight, curly, bob, and coloured — style and finish every unit to order, and stock hair-care products like our own Curly Solution.

Beyond the shop floor, we run an intensive wig-making training programme, and our work has been recognised with a Citation of Honor for Excellence in Wig Making.
